risk_note: Money path, RV2. BR-FUND-09 ② positive-difference candidates (FU-SETTLE-ADJ-POSITIVE; D10-769, D10-770, D10-780; contract CT-24zv). The generator takes every CREDITED order of the app and platform, one transaction per order under the order-key lock, and writes approval-route candidates only (no voucher, balance or booked change; approval is B2-09zc). Base grew (B_settle > booked_base): a member's row is the new share less the net already credited (frozen / appealing written as usual; forfeited, banned, deleting / deleted, minor get none); base unchanged (only the commission changed, zero base with reserve included): platform row only (money review r1 S0, r2 S0). The platform row is the plan's platform difference, either sign. 决-10: while settle.adjust.void_on_clawback.enabled is on (default) a settlement record written at or before the order's latest R8 / R9 clawback is skipped. D10-780: an older commission_version's pending rows of the same seq are voided (voided_stale_seq, reason superseded_by_version) with a system:settlement audit in the same transaction. One batch per run, created by the first order that writes. settle_jobs job=settle_adjust running → done; a run with a failed order fails as a whole and is delivered again, written orders are skipped then (money review r1 S2). The bill run that generates sends settle_adjust in its own transaction (bill/job.ts onGenerated); adminRunSettleAdjust queues the same job under idempotency with one audit. Frozen fixture: worker-catchup/kit.ts billRunsOf filters job = 'bill' (D10-787; 12 unchanged frozen tests in red_exempt, #2601).

reviews.note: Codex via codex-run.sh (D10-823: adversarial reviews back to Codex). r1 (couli-runs/B2-09zb/money-review-r1.json) fail: S0 the member diff also took off the open obligation's pending amount; S2 a failed order was only logged and the job recorded done. r2 (money-review-r2.json) fail: S0 with the base unchanged a member with a pending amount still got a row. Fixed in the implementation only (bbfd3907e, 48a533c1f); r3 (money-review-r3.json) pass, no findings. The r1 S0 (pending not taken off), r1 S2 (a failed order not swallowed) and r2 S0 (no member row when the base is unchanged) were found by the money review and have no rule test in this task (the rule-test rounds were used up; approvals 51 covered only the spec-test r1 findings): they get their tests in the follow-up test-change B2-09zf (D10-828, ledger #2633).

The tool counter was not bumped for the 4th (precedent B2-04zi / approvals 50). spec-test r1 by a fresh independent Claude (spec-test-review-r1.json) failed on three S1 coverage gaps (S1-1 minors: the owner ruled it out) and three S2; r2 by Codex (spec-test-review-r2.json, D10-823) passed with no findings and confirmed the kit.ts change is the filter only and the 12 red_exempt test bodies are unchanged; it is kept as a reference only: evidence-check (CT-06r) takes a Claude spec-test review for a claude-independent test author (D10-848). r3 by a fresh independent Claude (spec-test-review-r3.json) is the extra spec-test round approvals 51 allowed (D10-849; tool counter not bumped): pass, no findings, kit.ts filter and the 12 red_exempt bodies confirmed verbatim. Red: red/4 ok, 40 tests in 14 files. Mutations (couli-runs/B2-09zb/mutations.md): clawback gate, supersession, planner delta, forfeited rows (killed by the 3rd round's test) and settle_jobs completion all red.
